crossRefs.note: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered…
Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath…
Then because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.

translations.web: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
translations.bsb: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was beginning.
translations.kjv: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
translations.asv: And it was the day of the Preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
